information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BangaloreCubeOpen2024#50770-competitor-responsibilities) Only one guest per participant is allowed owing to space constraints in the venue
